Healing Flask.name: Healing Flask
Healing Flask.description: Restores 425 Health. Can be used to revive a downed Slayer. Always equipped in the first slot.

Aetherdrive Tonic.name: Aetherdrive Tonic
Aetherdrive Tonic.description: Increases the recharge rate of your lantern's ability by 100% for 60 seconds.

Assault Tonic.name: Assault Tonic
Assault Tonic.description: Grants 40% increased Stagger damage dealt for 60 seconds.

Blitz Tonic.name: Blitz Tonic
Blitz Tonic.description: Grants 15% increased attack speed for 60 seconds.

Bulwark Tonic.name: Bulwark Tonic
Bulwark Tonic.description: Reduces damage taken by 45% for the next 3 hits.

Frenzy Tonic.name: Frenzy Tonic
Frenzy Tonic.description: Grants 15% increased damage dealt for 60 seconds. Grants 30% if a Behemoth is enraged.

Insight Tonic.name: Insight Tonic
Insight Tonic.description: Grants 40% increased Wound damage dealt for 60 seconds.

Lifedrain Tonic.name: Lifedrain Tonic
Lifedrain Tonic.description: 12% of all damage dealt will heal all nearby Slayers for 30 seconds.

Stamina Tonic.name: Stamina Tonic
Stamina Tonic.description: Grants 50% increased stamina regen and 50% reduced stamina costs for 120 seconds.

Cleansing Pylon.name: Cleansing Pylon
Cleansing Pylon.description: Place a pylon that removes negative conditions from nearby Slayers and reduces their frostbite level by 25%. The pylon's aura will also prevent frostbite levels from increasing.

Inspiring Pylon.name: Inspiring Pylon
Inspiring Pylon.description: Place a pylon that grants 25% increased damage dealt to all nearby Slayers for 45 seconds.

Lifespring Pylon.name: Lifespring Pylon
Lifespring Pylon.description: Place a pylon that restores 15 health per second to nearby Slayers for 30 seconds.

Ironhide Pylon.name: Ironhide Pylon
Ironhide Pylon.description: Place a pylon that grants 40% decreased damage taken to all nearby Slayers for 45 seconds.
